'''Alina''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Teth (star)|Teth]] in the [[Teth system/Legends|Teth system]], located in the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Alina had one [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and, along with [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], was one of the two terrestrial planets in the system.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Teth system/Legends|Teth system]], except [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
